question.text: What annual fee is payable by a clearing member or self-clearing member in the currency derivatives segment till the registration is in force?

answer.text: Rs. 50,000 per year till registration is in force

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook specifies that a clearing member or self-clearing member must pay Rs. 50,000 per year till the registration is in force. This is a flat annual charge tied to the continuation of registration, not a turnover-linked fee. The Trap: The SEBI turnover fee for currency derivatives is a separate item (Rs. 10 per crore of turnover) and is sometimes confused with this annual registration-linked charge. The two are different obligations. Note: The annual Rs. 50,000 is in addition to exchange transaction charges, clearing corporation charges, GST, stamp duty and brokerage. Treat each cost head separately when calculating total cost of trading.
